Add profiles to the queue and use Move U: Add profiles to the queue and use Move Up/Down to order them. Removing from the queue does not delete the profile. All HUDs share one sampling interval; sh: All HUDs share one sampling interval; shorter intervals use more resources. Clocks update by seconds, while HTTP and balance sources keep their own refresh/cache intervals. Faster global sampling does not bypass a source's cache.

Enable click cycling to advance through: Enable click cycling to advance through the queue even with automatic cycling off. Each HUD advances its own instance and resets its cycle timer. Transparent areas remain click-through. Empty or single-item queues do not switch.
Enable multiple HUDs under Experimental: Enable multiple HUDs under Experimental Features, add/name a secondary HUD and select it for editing. The selected HUD is highlighted. Save & Apply a new instance before previewing it. Removing a secondary instance does not remove the primary HUD.

Initial and recovered samples establish: Initial and recovered samples establish a baseline without popping up.
